scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm -w @wheleers/config run build && npm -w @wheleers/kafka-schemas run build && npm -w @wheleers/kafka-client run build && npm -w @wheleers/db run build && npm -w @wheleers/multi-chain-wallet run build && npm -w @wheleers/payments run build
scripts.build:apps: npm -w @wheleers/group-ride run build && npm -w @wheleers/notification-worker run build && npm -w @wheleers/analytics-worker run build && npm -w @wheleers/payment-service run build && npm -w @wheleers/ride-service run build && npm -w @wheleers/wallet-service run build && npm -w @wheleers/api-gateway run build && npm -w @wheleers/whatsapp-gateway run build && npm -w @wheleers/mcp-server run build
scripts.pm2:reload: node scripts/check-env.mjs && pm2 delete ecosystem.config.cjs ; pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs && pm2 save
scripts.start:local: npm run infra:up && npm run build && npm run db:migrate:deploy && npm run pm2:start
scripts.test:wallet-payment-integration: npm run build && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && node test/dist/payment-wallet.integration.js
scripts.test:ride-rehydrate: npm -w @wheleers/db run build && npm -w @wheleers/ride-service run build && node --test --test-force-exit test/ride-rehydrate.test.js
scripts.test:driver-bids: npm -w @wheleers/db run build && npm -w @wheleers/api-gateway run build && node --test --test-force-exit test/driver-bids.test.js
scripts.flow:push:forms: npm run flow:push:edit-trip && npm run flow:push:offers && npm run flow:push:quick-actions
scripts.test:all: npm run build && node --test --test-force-exit --test-concurrency=1 test/llm-provider.test.js test/geocoding-fallback.test.js test/whatsapp-amounts.test.js test/wallet-intent.test.js test/rider-memory.test.js test/face-check.test.js test/deposit-split.test.js test/bank-names.test.js test/live-map.test.js test/paystack-webhook.test.js test/wallet-pin.test.js test/rider-signup.test.js test/driver-bids.test.js test/booking-conversation.test.js test/otp-channels.test.js test/group-ride.test.js test/ride-page.test.js test/wallet-holds.test.js test/service-usage.test.js
scripts.test:live-map: npm -w @wheleers/db run build && npm -w @wheleers/api-gateway run build && node --test --test-force-exit test/live-map.test.js
scripts.test:wallet-pin: npm -w @wheleers/db run build && npm -w @wheleers/api-gateway run build && node --test --test-force-exit test/wallet-pin.test.js
scripts.test:payments: npm -w @wheleers/config run build && npm -w @wheleers/payments run build && node --test test/bank-names.test.js test/deposit-split.test.js test/paystack-webhook.test.js
